1. Hover over the **Actions** column on the far-right for the field you want to recalculate.

1. When the **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu appears, click on it and select **{{< fa arrows-rotate >}} Recalculate Now**.

    The recalculation starts right away and runs in the background. It can take a few minutes. A notification shows its progress, and you can't start another recalculation of the same field until it finishes. If you leave the page, the recalculation keeps running.

1. When the recalculation finishes, the notification shows how many values were recalculated and how many could not be recalculated, if any.

    If the field is already being recalculated, the notification says so. Try again when that recalculation finishes.
